title: Gender Reveal Party Ideas: At Home, Games and Guest Photos | Albums.ink
desc: Gender reveal party ideas for families in the US: at-home reveals, simple games, food and one QR album that collects every guest photo and video.
h1: Gender reveal party ideas: simple reveals, games and a way to keep every photo
lead: Searches like “gender reveal party ideas at home”, “for family” and “games” show what most parents-to-be in the US actually want: a relaxed afternoon with the people closest to them, a reveal everyone can see, and the reactions saved. Here are ideas that work in a living room or a backyard — and a simple way to collect the photos and videos guests take.
body: ## Reveal ideas that work at home
- Cake reveal: the bakery gets the sealed envelope from your doctor; you cut the cake in front of everyone.
- Balloon box: a big box filled with pink or blue balloons that float out when you open it.
- Confetti cannons: a handheld cannon each for the two of you. Keep it outdoors and pick up afterwards.
- Big sibling reveal: an older child opens a gift with a T-shirt that says “Big Brother of a…”.
- Pet reveal: the dog wears a bandana hidden under a plain one that you swap at the moment.
Skip anything with flames or pyrotechnics — a reveal is about the faces, not the smoke.
## Gender reveal party games
- Team pink vs team blue: guests pick a side with a sticker or bracelet when they arrive.
- Old wives’ tales quiz: cravings, heartburn, how the bump is carried — guests vote and keep score.
- Baby photo match: guess which baby picture belongs to which parent.
- Prediction cards: due date, weight, hair color. Keep them for after the birth.
## Food that keeps it easy
Pink and blue cupcakes, a candy table, sliders or a taco bar. For a family afternoon, a potluck works well — the grandparents usually want to bring something anyway.
## Keep every reaction with one QR code
The best moment lasts about two seconds, and it is filmed from twenty angles on twenty phones. An event album on Albums gathers them in one place:
1. Create the album, e.g. “Baby Miller — boy or girl?”.
2. Print the QR on the welcome sign and next to the cake.
3. Guests scan with their phone camera and upload photos and videos from the browser — nothing to install.
4. Turn on “Hold guest photos” if you want to approve uploads before they appear.
5. After the party, download the whole album as one ZIP.
Guests who upload without signing in appear anonymously. Signed-in guests also get a private draft copy containing only their own uploads.

faq: What are easy gender reveal party ideas at home?
A cake reveal, a balloon box or confetti cannons outdoors, plus a simple team pink vs team blue game.
What games can we play at a gender reveal?
Team pink vs team blue, an old wives’ tales quiz, a baby photo match and prediction cards.
How do we collect the videos guests take of the reveal?
Put a QR code next to the cake. Guests scan it and upload photos and videos from the browser into one album.
Do guests need an account to upload?
No. Uploads without signing in appear anonymously; signed-in guests also get a private draft copy of only their own uploads.
